MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_FALLING_BLADE.des:
Whatever its current kind, [gold]Onimaru[/gold] makes 1 [gold]Iai[/gold] on the target ({IaiDamage} damage). The kind does not change.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: If this kills the enemy, gain {Energy} energy.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_NIGHT_WATCH.title: Night Watch
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_NIGHT_WATCH.descr:
Whatever its current kind, [gold]Onimaru[/gold] guards once with [gold]Goei[/gold] ({AutoBlock} [gold]Block[/gold]). The kind does not change.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
[gold]Command[/gold]: [gold]Onimaru[/gold] immediately makes 1 auto attack of its current kind ({IaiDamage} damage with Iai).
[gold]Combo[/gold]: [gold]Command[/gold] once more.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_FIVE_STANCES.desc:
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] strikes once with each kind: [gold]Goei[/gold], [gold]Taima[/gold], [gold]Iai[/gold], [gold]Ranbu[/gold] and [gold]Giri[/gold] (Taima and Iai hit the target). The kind does not change.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
